text:
Taylor: FYI UX pass from QA: opening the Activity modal while a toast shows causes the primary CTA to move down ~9px. Repro on Chrome/Win and Safari/Mac. Screenshot: https://placeholder.img/activity-toast-shift.png
Isha: can repro. Toast is in the document flow so it pushes the header. Also seeing inconsistent button copy: some CTAs say "Confirm" and others "Confirm changes".
Ken: quick proposal: 1) move toasts to a fixed thin layer (centered, transform animation), 2) keep menus/modals portal'd above toasts, 3) stronger focus ring for icon-only buttons (+ aria-label audit), 4) introduce a component-scoped spacing token for toolbars and action groups so we don't mutate global tokens.
Maya: agree. For toasts CSS idea:
```css
.rw-toast { position: fixed; top: 14px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(-8px); opacity: 0; transition: transform .16s, opacity .12s; pointer-events: none; }
.rw-toast.show { transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0); opacity: 1; pointer-events: auto; }
```
Taylor: Accessibility: when toasts are fixed and non-interactive ensure they still announce via an aria-live region (polite), and don't steal focus. Also confirm that opening a modal traps focus correctly even if a toast is visible.
Isha: Focus ring: current icon button ring is 1px subtle. Suggest 2px solid using --color-interactive-focus with outline-offset: 2px. For dark surfaces use --color-focus-inverse. Also enforce aria-labels on all icon-only buttons.
Ken: spacing token thought: add --component-toolbar-gap = 8px in tokens but only use in toolbar component. If we later want global change we can promote. This avoids unexpected ripples.
Maya: microcopy: prefer longer form in dialogs ("Confirm changes") and short inline toasts ("Saved"). Let's add a short note to content-guidelines.md.
Taylor: QA plan: e2e that triggers a toast then opens modal while tabbing; assert activeElement is modal close button after open, and header y-offset delta < 6px. Also visual snapshot of toolbar before/after.
Isha: I'll open a small PR with: toast layer change, toolbar token override, focus ring update, aria-label audit, and copy standardization. Will include a mobile variant (shorter toast timeout and max-height).
design-bot: PR opened: redwood/design-system#812 — "toasts: fixed layer + toolbar gap + focus & copy harmonize" (assigned to Isha)
Ken: when changing z-indexes please add a short z-order table in DESIGN_TOKENS.md: base < content < tooltips < toasts < menus < modals < overlays. Helps avoid future surprises.
Maya: tagging @platform-ux for awareness. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Isha: linking PR in ~45m for review.
Taylor: :+1:
